entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 0032 of 2023, under Sections 323, 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Vikas Nagar,
District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 24.02.2023 at 18:44 hrs against the applicant, describing him as Mausa of the informant, alleging that the informant was living in the house of maternal grandmother of her husband and Mausa of her husband (applicant)
also lived in the same house and while the informant was sleeping at about 02.30 am on 22.03.2023 the applicant raped her.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that he is innocent, he has be falsely implicated in the present case for the reason that the informant and her husband want to usurp the property of the applicant's mother-in-law.

It has further been stated in the affidavit that the informant's husband was also present in the night of the alleged incident and nothing has been stated regarding presence of her husband by the informant.

entities.text: Rajendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been stated in the FIR itself that the applicant is a constable in Uttar Pradesh Police.

5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the informant herself has stated that the applicant is Mausa of her husband; that from the averments made in the FIR as also in the affidavit it appears that the informant was residing in the house of her husband's nani and the applicant was also residing in the same house; as the applicant is a constable in Uttar Pradesh Police there appears to be no apprehension of absconding in case he is released on bail; the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 16.03.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
